tei:div.tei:p: sngon 'gro'i zhu tshigade yang 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa'i ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/ phan bde'i rtsa lag tu gyur pa/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang pos gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa dang 'tshams shing*/ thar 'dod skye bo yongs kyi 'jug ngogs dam par gyur pa'i chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa yang lta ba rten 'byung dang*/ spyod pa 'tshe ba med pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid yin la/ de yang gtad rabs bdun dang*/ shing rta chen po gnyis la sogs pa las/ rim par 'dzam gling gi tha gru kun tu khyab pa las/ rang cag gangs can par mtshon na/ mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid chen po mes po bka' drin can rnams kyi 'phrin las kyi 'od snang*/ phyi rabs 'gro ba'i lam ston sgron me lta bu'i bstan bcos sa chen po'i rdul ltar grangs tsam yang bgrang bar dka' ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa las/ deng dus spyi tshogs la dgos gal che ba khag cig mkho btus kyis/ phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'di nyid/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang dang*/ nga tsho'i dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gnyis mnyam las kyis rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du rim pa bstar chags su 'bul rgyu yin/ de yang da lta'i char phyi dngos po'i 'phel 'gyur dang*/ nang bsam pa'i shes tshad cha mi snyoms pa'i dus rabs kyi kyog mtshams 'dir*/ smra shes shing don go ba 'gro ba mi'i rigs spyi dang*/ khyad par du spyi tshogs la 'gan khur gyi bsam blo ldan pa'i shes yon can rnams kyis/ bsam blo gu yangs dang*/ mig rgyang ring po'i sgo nas bsam blo'i langs phyogs ma nor bar legs nyes kyi gnas la bsam gzhig dang*/ spyi tshogs la rang nus kyis 'gan khur dang zhabs zhu gang 'grub byas nas/ 'cham mthun brtan brling dang shes dpal ldan pa'i khor yug cig 'dzugs skrun byed pa ni/

rang cag skye bo kun gyi phrag thog tu bab pa'i 'os 'gan zhig yin snyam/ de yang nged zhib 'jug khang gi lo ngo bcu phrag lhag tsam gyi ring*/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og /mdo dbus khams gsum gyi sa gnas so sor dngos su bskyod cing*/ dpe rnying dpe dkon rnams srung skyob dang*/ 'tshol bsdu/ nyams gso sogs kyi las ka'i brgyud rim nang*/ gal che'i dpe dkon mang po zhig rnyed son byung ba rnams/ bka' gdams gsung 'bum phyogs bsgrig dang*/ bka' gdams gsung 'bum gces btus/ mes po'i shul bzhag /phyag bris gces btus/ shes bya'i gter bum/ mkhan slob chos gsum sogs kyi dpe tshogs rnams so sor bsdu bsgrigs dang par bskrun zhus dang zhu bzhin pa las/ da lam mkhyen brtse'i 'od snang zhes pa'i dpe tshogs 'd-i yang*/ ji skad du/ 'jug pa las/ snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang*/ /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pas chos kyi rnam grangs ji snyed cig gsungs pa'i snying po/ mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin de nyid thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab kyis rang rgyud la skye dgos pa yin la/ de lta bu'i thos bsam bya yul gyi gzhung lugs ni/ 'chos skyob yon tan gnyis ldan gyi bka' dang*/ bstan bcos rnam dag la rag las pas/ 'dir yang brjod bya gtso bo deng dus kyi spyi tshogs la dgos gal che zhing bsam blo'i slob gso la med du mi rung ba byang chub sems kyi bslab bya dang 'brel ba'i zab chos du ma dang*/ dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi rin thang ldan pa/ yig tshogs nyung zhing blta bde ba/ grub mtha' phyogs su ma lhung ba/ spyi tshogs dza drag dang rnyog 'dzing sogs kyis yid sems nyams nyes su gyur tshe/ blta klog byas na blo rnal du dbab pa sogs dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa dang*/ rin thang ldan pa'i dpe tshogs zhig lags pas/

rgya che'i mkhyen dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgyes gzigs gnang ste/ nang bsam blo'i shes yon gyi 'phel phyogs yang phyi dngos po'i 'phel rgyas dang do mnyam pa'i/ shes 'byor gnyis ldan gyi spyi tshogs bzang po zhig phyogs dang tha gru kun tu yong thub pa'i re smon yang yang zhu ba lags/ 'di yang mkhyen dpyod lhag bsam zla dang bral ba'i mkhas dbang gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' yis bskul ma gnang bar ji mi snyam du 'dor ma phod par cung zad tsam du smras pa'o/ /
